specification.boundaries: P_HIGH if r>(N-S)/N; else P_MID if r>(N-S-A)/N; else P_BASE if r>(N-S-A-B)/N; else P_BELOW. Integer numerator comparisons avoid float boundary ambiguity. Exact boundary belongs to lower band.
specification.old_band: ML=sum(PAVA(p2,p3,p5))/sum(frozen head base_rates); S>=2 A>=1.5 B>=1 C otherwise
specification.train_volume_preservation: Exact S/A/B/C counts on same training rows; test counts deliberately NOT forced
specification.training_cutoff: training entry_minute<920; models exact saved train IDs already embody this scope
specification.training_percentile: Let keys=(-pP,timestamp,symbol) ascending, N training rows; r=(N-number of training keys strictly less than current key)/N. Includes own training key. Test r uses training insertion index only. This is a full-order empirical CDF (score ties resolved by frozen order).
specification.training_rows: Exact identical completed pre-cutoff train_entry_ids of frozen H2/H3/H5 and MOVE_P block; no test rows
specification.training_score_apply: Saved models predict only; model fitting/calibration/score-stream regeneration=0
